lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits. Approximately 9-10 vertical columns are visible between the pectoral and first dorsal fin, with 3-5 distinct maxima per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Thin vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, particularly evident in the mid-lateral region where they form a lattice-like geometric structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high (top) to low (bottom) intensity, extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs of smaller diameter relative to the lateral flank spots.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct dark, elongated silhouette of a remora is visible attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pelvic fins.
